prompts.v2: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: original game cloud sprite atlas with TRUE transparent alpha, no sky or ground. Exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, 8 separate cells, wide canvas aspect 2:1. Each cloud stays fully INSIDE its cell with 8 percent transparent padding on all sides; no overlap between cells, no clipped edges. Photographic real atmospheric water vapor clouds: intricate soft billowing lobes, warm neutral white highlights illuminated from upper left, pale blue-grey shaded undersides, wispy feathered semitransparent edges, clearly defined coherent body rather than smoke or cotton balls. No labels, borders, text, watermark, checkerboard, black background, blue background or sunset coloring. Distinct silhouettes in every cell. Neutral daylight lighting so runtime can tint into red sunset. Top row left to right: broad flat-bottom fair-weather cumulus with one low peak; leaning lopsided cumulus with a trailing wisp; tall cauliflower cumulus tower; two connected low rounded cumulus humilis. Bottom row: loose small altocumulus cloudlets with gaps; delicate long windblown cirrus feathers; ragged broken medium cumulus with a wispy tail; rippled rows of small altocumulus.
